message.text:
can you help me create and add a small role-based access control (RBAC) system built with Mongoose for this project?

The big idea utilizes three collections to model user permissions:

Role: the list of roles
RoleUser: the link between a user and a role
RoleAccess: the actual permissions granted to a role for each menu/item/action

please follow the schemas for the models

role

- name: role name (“Guest” and “System Administrator”)
- active: whether the role is active (Y/N)

roleUser

- idroles: the role id
- idusers: the user id

roleAccess (actual permission table)

- idroles: which role this permission belongs to
- access: the feature/page/menu name
- add: whether the role can add
- edit: whether the role can edit
- delete: whether the role can delete

So for example:

role = “System Administrator”
access = “User Management”
add = 1
edit = 1
delete = 1

this is only an idea so if you need to tweak some things, you may. the reference i have also has methods for managing roles like inserting/updating/deleting roles and etc. I'm not sure how to do that but you can utilize the idea as well. I need help with the controllers and routes as well. Can you do that?
